title: pollinia viminea
intro: Pollinia viminea, commonly known as Viper's Bugloss or Blue Thimble, is a flowering plant species in the borage family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various ailments such as fever, sore throats, and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Pollinia viminea include its ability to act as a expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory issues, and as an anti-spasmodic, easing muscle cramps and spasms. The bioactive constituents of Pollinia viminea include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
